explanation: I used `WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment()` and `next_token()` to walk the fragment in document order, appending only ordinary `#text` tokens plus opener-carried text from `TITLE` and `TEXTAREA` via `get_modifiable_text()`. I then truncated the UTF-8 text by Unicode code points using `mb_strlen`/`mb_substr` when available, with a PCRE UTF-8 fallback.
